vsftpd_2.3.4.description: Backdoor found in vsftpd 2.3.4, allowing full remote command execution.
vsftpd_2.3.4.remediation: Update vsftpd to version 3.0.0 or later.

apache_2.4.41.description: Path traversal and file disclosure vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.41.
apache_2.4.41.remediation: Update Apache to version 2.4.51 or later.

openssh_4.7p1.description: Predictable PRNG in Debian-based OpenSSH, allowing easy key recovery.
openssh_4.7p1.remediation: Regenerate all SSH keys and update OpenSSH.
